name: Ring Sort: Color Hoop Puzzle
description: Stack colored wooden rings, fill each peg with one color and watch it snap shut. Play the free demo right in your browser.

name: Marble Rush: Quick Brain Game
description: Biggest or smallest? Spot the right marble and tap its color before time runs out. One rule. One tap. One more try.

name: Find Numbers 1 to 100
description: A hundred numbers. One sharp eye. Find and tap them in order, challenge a friend or take on the AI.

name: Last Tower: Monster Siege
description: One archer. One tower. A whole horde to stop. Aim your bow, discover powerful skills and hold the line.

name: Stickman Archer Duel: Bow War
description: Read the wind, land the perfect headshot and challenge the champions of eight civilizations. Pull, aim and let the arrows fly.

name: Stickman Block Defense
description: Stack your wall. Clear a line. Fire a volley. A new puzzle-defense adventure with mighty heroes and epic castle sieges.

name: Rooftop Last Stand
description: Hold the roof. Survive the night. Aim, land headshots and crack open supply crates between waves to power up your arsenal.

name: Arrow Escape: Tap Away Puzzle
description: Tap a paper arrow and watch it fly off the board. Find the right order, unlock keys, melt ice and decorate Pip's cozy home.

name: Bolt Pop: Unscrew Puzzle
description: Unscrew colorful screws, drop them into matching toolboxes and watch the plates fall. 300 levels, each proven solvable, and a Robot Garage to decorate.
